intro.title: Celebrity Danube River Cruises
paragraphs: The Danube River is one of Europe's most important waterways, connecting imperial cities, historic towns, vineyard-covered landscapes and cultural destinations across Central Europe.

Celebrity River Cruises brings its new premium river cruise experience to the Danube for 2027 and 2028, with itineraries connecting destinations such as Budapest, Bratislava, Vienna, the Wachau Valley, Melk, Passau, Regensburg and Vilshofen. Celebrity's current Danube program includes 7-night itineraries, with selected journeys featuring overnight stays and opportunities to add Before and After Stays.

For travelers considering a first European river cruise—or comparing Celebrity with other premium river cruise lines—the Danube offers a strong combination of history, architecture, scenic sailing, food, wine and major Central European cities.

quickAnswer.title: What Are Celebrity Danube River Cruises?
quickAnswer.text: Celebrity Danube River Cruises are premium European river cruises sailing the Danube, with 2027 and 2028 itineraries visiting destinations including Budapest, Bratislava, Vienna, the Wachau Valley and German river cities. Celebrity's Danube program includes 7-night sailings, one shore excursion per day, meals, beverages and Wi-Fi, with Before and After Stay opportunities available on selected journeys.

glance.title: Celebrity Danube River Cruises at a Glance
glance.note: Celebrity's current Danube offerings include Upper Danube journeys between Budapest and German destinations, as well as Christmas market itineraries and additional Lower Danube experiences.

whereToSail.title: Where Does Celebrity Danube River Cruises Sail?
whereToSail.subtitle: Celebrity's Danube itineraries are designed around the river's major capitals, historic towns and scenic stretches. Depending on the itinerary, travelers can experience:

items.title: Budapest
items.description: Iconic Danube waterfront, historic Buda Castle, Grand Parliament, and thermal baths.

items.title: Bratislava
items.description: Charming medieval Old Town, hilltop castle, cobblestone alleys, and riverside cafes.

items.title: Vienna
items.description: Imperial palaces, grand opera houses, world-class museums, and classical music legacy.

items.title: Hainburg
items.description: Historic riverside setting featuring ancient medieval fortifications and lush landscapes.

items.title: Wachau Valley
items.description: UNESCO World Heritage cultural landscape with terrace vineyards and castle ruins.

items.title: Melk
items.description: Home to the world-famous Benedictine Melk Abbey overlooking the peaceful Danube.

items.title: Engelhartszell
items.description: Austria's only Trappist monastery, surrounded by Upper Austrian river forests.

items.title: Vilshofen
items.description: Historic Bavarian river port and gateway town on the scenic German Danube.

items.title: Passau
items.description: The City of Three Rivers, known for St. Stephen's Cathedral and baroque beauty.

items.title: Regensburg
items.description: Impeccably preserved UNESCO medieval city center and ancient Stone Bridge.

items.title: Linz
items.description: Dynamic blend of contemporary media arts, classical history, and Linzer Torte.

items.title: Dürnstein
items.description: Blue baroque church tower and medieval castle where King Richard the Lionheart was held.

items.title: Krems
items.description: Historic wine-producing town gateway to the breathtaking Lower Danube valley.

items.title: Additional Danube Ports
items.description: Diverse seasonal stops, Christmas market towns, and lower river cultural jewels.

whereToSail.footerNote: The exact ports depend on the sailing and itinerary direction. Celebrity's 7-night Budapest & Vienna itinerary, for example, travels between Budapest and Vilshofen and includes Bratislava, Hainburg, Vienna, the Wachau Valley, Melk and Engelhartszell.

route.title: Celebrity Danube River Cruise Map & Route
route.subtitle: A typical Upper Danube itinerary can move between Hungary, Slovakia, Austria and Germany, combining major capitals with historic towns and scenic river landscapes.
route.exampleRoute: Budapest → Bratislava → Hainburg → Vienna → Wachau Valley → Melk → Engelhartszell → Vilshofen

route.note: This route combines Budapest's Danube waterfront, Bratislava's historic center, Austrian river scenery, Vienna's imperial culture, Wachau Valley vineyards, Melk, Bavarian river destinations and scenic Upper Danube sailing. Celebrity currently offers this 7-night Budapest-to-Vilshofen itinerary on ships including Celebrity Seeker and Celebrity Boundless.

cards.description: Spring can be attractive for travelers interested in mild weather, fresh scenery, city sightseeing, scenic river landscapes and European cultural travel.

cards.title: Summer Danube River Cruises
cards.description: Summer provides longer daylight hours and more opportunities for exploring riverside destinations, with long days, outdoor sightseeing, walking tours and scenic sailing.

cards.title: Fall Danube River Cruises
cards.description: Fall can be particularly appealing for travelers interested in vineyards, harvest-season scenery and comfortable sightseeing along the Wachau Valley.

cards.title: Christmas Danube River Cruises

beforeAfter.title: Danube River Cruise Before & After Stays
beforeAfter.subtitle: A Celebrity Danube River Cruise does not have to begin or end when the ship does. Celebrity offers Before and After Stays that allow travelers to add time in European cities before or after their river sailing.

budapestBefore.title: Budapest Before Your Danube Cruise
budapestBefore.description: Budapest is one of the most natural places to extend a Danube River cruise. A pre-cruise stay can give you additional time for Danube sightseeing, historic architecture, thermal baths, museums, local dining, historic neighborhoods and Hungarian culture. Rather than arriving immediately before the ship departs, adding extra nights makes your European vacation feel more relaxed.
highlights: Extra nights at a centrally located luxury Budapest hotel
Private evening Danube riverbank illuminated tours
Relaxing morning at Széchenyi or Gellért thermal baths
Guided walking tour of the Castle Hill district
Seamless transfer directly to the Celebrity river ship

viennaAfter.title: Vienna After or Before Your Danube Cruise
viennaAfter.description: Vienna is another strong destination for extending a Danube journey. Additional time allows travelers to explore palaces, museums, classical music, historic cafés, art, architecture and local neighborhoods. Celebrity's Danube itinerary can already include an overnight stay in Vienna on selected sailings, making the city particularly suitable for travelers who want more time ashore.

faqs.question: 1. What is a Celebrity Danube River Cruise?
faqs.answer: A Celebrity Danube River Cruise is a premium European river cruise experience sailing the Danube, with itineraries visiting destinations including Budapest, Bratislava, Vienna, the Wachau Valley and German river cities.

faqs.question: 2. When do Celebrity Danube River Cruises begin?
faqs.answer: Celebrity's inaugural river cruises begin in August 2027, with Danube and Rhine itineraries offered for 2027 and 2028.

faqs.question: 3. How long are Celebrity Danube River Cruises?
faqs.answer: Celebrity currently offers 7-night Danube itineraries, including Budapest-to-Vilshofen and other Upper Danube routes.

faqs.question: 4. Which cities does Celebrity visit on the Danube?
faqs.answer: Celebrity Danube itineraries can include Budapest, Bratislava, Vienna, Hainburg, the Wachau Valley, Melk, Passau, Regensburg, Linz and Vilshofen, although exact ports depend on the itinerary.

faqs.question: 5. Does Celebrity Danube River Cruises sail from Budapest?
faqs.answer: Yes. Celebrity offers Danube itineraries beginning in Budapest, including 7-night journeys from Budapest to Vilshofen and Budapest to Regensburg.

faqs.question: 6. Does Celebrity Danube River Cruises sail to Vienna?
faqs.answer: Yes. Vienna is one of the featured destinations on Celebrity Danube itineraries, with selected sailings including an overnight stay.

faqs.question: 7. What is included on Celebrity Danube River Cruises?
faqs.answer: Celebrity states that river cruise fares include meals, beverages, Wi-Fi, entertainment options and one shore excursion per day.

faqs.question: 8. Are shore excursions included on Celebrity Danube cruises?
faqs.answer: Yes. Celebrity includes one shore excursion every day on its river cruises.

faqs.question: 9. Is Wi-Fi included on Celebrity Danube River Cruises?
faqs.answer: Yes. Wi-Fi is included as part of the Celebrity River Cruises fare.

faqs.question: 10. Are drinks included on Celebrity Danube River Cruises?
faqs.answer: Yes. Celebrity states that beverages, including alcoholic beverages, are included in the river cruise fare.

faqs.question: 11. What is the best time for a Celebrity Danube River Cruise?
faqs.answer: The best time depends on your interests. Spring and summer are suited to general sightseeing, fall can appeal to travelers interested in vineyards and seasonal scenery, and late November through December is best for Christmas markets.

faqs.question: 12. Are Celebrity Danube River Cruises good for Christmas markets?
faqs.answer: Yes. Celebrity offers dedicated Danube Christmas Market Cruises, including itineraries between Budapest and Nuremberg.

faqs.question: 13. What ships sail Celebrity Danube River Cruises?
faqs.answer: Celebrity's Danube fleet includes Celebrity Compass, Celebrity Seeker and Celebrity Boundless, with these ships appearing on current Danube itineraries.

faqs.question: 14. Does Celebrity River Cruises offer Before and After Stays?
faqs.answer: Yes. Celebrity offers pre- and post-cruise experiences designed to extend river journeys into iconic European cities, including Budapest and Prague.

faqs.question: 15. Are Celebrity Danube River Cruises worth it?
faqs.answer: They can be an excellent choice for travelers seeking a new premium river cruise experience with modern ships, included daily excursions, Central European city access, included beverages and optional pre- and post-cruise extensions.
